verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Slate automatically selects the right model per task, with a concrete example of routing planning/search/execution across different models (Claude, GLM, Codex) without user intervention, and also allow manual override of default models per slot if desired. This directly matches the story's pricing-limits theme of avoiding manual model selection overhead. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that automatic routing works well in practice, and no detail on how routing decisions interact with cost/credit consumption.
